profile.headline: Information Technology and Services Professional
profile.summary:
Objective
A  position to utilize and expand my database and software development knowledge and skills

Specialties: .net,  administration,  cabling,  cat5,  computer hardware,  crystal reports,  css,  database administration,  dos,  frontpage,  help desk support,  html,  inventory management,  laptop computers,  mas 90,  microsoft c #,   microsoft access, excel,  outlook, publisher,  word, microsoft windows 2000, nt 4.0, xp, Vista,  mysql, networking,  perl,  php, sql,  sql server 7, 2000, 2005, sybase,  tcp/ip,  upgrades,  vba,  visio,  visual basic,  visual basic 6.0,  visual studio,  vm,  xml,

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Managed the installation projects for Micros POS systems.  Including the 9700, 3700 and e7 point of sale systems.
Provided second level support to the help desk when service calls needed escalation.
Designed, built, and implemented a test lab for new software version release testing and system problem duplication and resolution in a VM environment.
Designed, built and implemented custom SQL scripts to automate common support and project implementation tasks.
Designed, built and implemented custom data export scripts per customer requests using SQL and Perl.
Designed, built and implemented custom interface scripts using Micros' proprietary ISL scripting language.
Built application and database servers for the Micros 9700 enterprise solution systems, based on Windows 2003 server and MS SQL Server 2005.
Built custom Crystal reports for Micros 3700 system.
Provided in-house network and system support as a Domain Administrator.

positions.title: Slot Technical Parts Manager
positions.description:
Maintain parts inventory, including ordering, inventory control, vendor licensing, parts RMA for all Slot Technical equipment.
Help prepare budget for Capital expenditures for Department.  Track expenditures to ensure compliance with budgetary requirements.
Design, build and implement a MS Access database solution for tracking of all inventories, ordering, receiving and cost of required parts.
Design, build and implement a MS Access database solution for the receiving, verification and tracking of all Gaming controlled Eproms and other electronic media devices.
Designed Excel templates for the automation of daily administrative tasks in the Slot Technical Department.
Install and upgrade software on Departmental laptops and PDA's.  To include Windows XP O/S, Windows based applications and DOS based applications.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
Installed and maintained networked database driven systems Utilizing a combination of T10/T100 wired and 802.11b wireless networks with TCP/IP and named pipes protocols.  Including installation of required servers and software setup for remote PC and tablets.  Utilizing Windows 9x, 2000, XP, NT4.0, 2000 Server, 2003 Server, SQL Server 7, SQL Server 2000.
Installed wired networks for system, including Cat5 cable and twisted pair RS485 cable installation and termination with industry standard connectors and Telco 66/110 punch blocks.
Provide in field engineering support and training for customers and Progressive Gaming Inc technicians on all proprietary Windows based and DOS based applications in the Midwest and Northeast regions. 
Traveled globally as a systems specialist dealing with real-time software and hardware failures in casino systems
Designed, built and implemented a program for the tracking of parts for the Midwest region of Progressive Gaming Inc utilizing VB 6.0, MS Access, and Crystal Reports..

positions.title: Slot Technician
positions.description:
Install and provide preventative maintenance for slot equipment.
Maintain master database file system for all slot operations at casino on AS400 computers running AIX.
Train new Technicians.
Plan, organize and oversee expansion of slot floor. Including updating of Auto Cad files, submission of all paperwork to Gaming Compliance offices, building of project time line, and ordering of new slot machines.
